title: Practice 2: Prepositional endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: He was born in the 19th century.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Переходить дорогу в ___ (неположенный) месте опасно и незаконно.
exercises.prompt: Jaywalking is dangerous and illegal.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Моя жена - врач. Она работает в ___ (педиатрический) клинике.
exercises.prompt: My wife is a doctor. She works in a pediatric clinic.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Том и Мэри съехались, чтобы сэкономить на ___ (арендный) плате.
exercises.prompt: Tom and Mary moved in together to save money on rent.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Том обжирается всякий раз, когда ест в ___ (тот) ресторане.
exercises.prompt: Tom gorges himself whenever he eats at that restaurant.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.
